content: <thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 183.0451. This mass matches well with a sodium adduct ([M + Na]⁺) of a neutral molecule of mass ≈ 160.053 Da. The formula C₁₀H₈O₂ gives an exact neutral mass of 160.05243 Da, and adding Na (22.989218 Da) yields a calculated [M + Na]⁺ m/z of 183.04165, within a few ppm of the observed value. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C₁₀H₈O₂Na.
